invariants.meaning: Every valid runtime and observation reference pins only its selected image, regardless of absent or stale owner directories. The older runtime-only inspection stays separate.
Complete supplied cleanup and exact acquired custody precede private removal. Prove private absence before global unlink; preserve all other references and every image.

Repeated observation preserves the original hold and target snapshots while current runtime/source custody remains. Its hold metadata is outside stable target evidence. A retired private workspace cannot satisfy a fresh or repeated live-source check.

Archival derives fixed private content files solely from retained target bytes; it can follow runtime retirement. Complete readback, identities and descriptor closure precede a returned archive receipt.

Release requires the original sealed selection and every selected owner receipt in order. Completed, failed and cancelled work can all be settled; missing ownership cannot be inferred from a successful outcome.
Archive custody and supplied work settlement precede coordination. Release only the exact observation hold, preserve other owners and images, and close every acquired descriptor.

A later failure cannot roll back a successful unlink. Returned failure is not proof a hold still exists. Preserve actual effects and current ownership separately; never retry or reconstruct implicitly.
Only explicit maintenance removes a selected complete unreferenced image. Another image and all other references remain intact. Partial or malformed state rejects; no eviction or automatic repair.

The existing checked lock serializes bounded storage operations. No caller-supplied callback, native query or process launch is admitted under this coordinator. Real external ownership/transport and contention remain separate.

scope: Source-bound prospective inactive lifetime domain only. No filesystem experiment, original qualifier, native process, compiler, collector or live canonical store. Existing modules admit isolated case paths; promotion to actual canonical storage, native authentication, returned-stage transport, late-launch prevention, public collector/projection integration and historical startup/parent/full CI/push remain owned prerequisites.
